name: O Circuit, round the Paine massif
why: Eight days all the way round the massif: the empty north side, John Gardner Pass and the Southern Ice Field, then the W.
book: Only counter-clockwise, and every camp must be booked in order before you enter (Las Torres, Vertice, CONAF). The back side opens around November and closes in early April.
water: Streams and camps; food at the huts on the W part only.
dangers: John Gardner Pass (1,200 m) is the most exposed point of the park: rangers open it only in the morning and close it in storms.
Deep mud and fallen trees on the descent to Paso camp.
turnaround: Leave Los Perros camp at first light: the pass must be crossed before the afternoon wind.

points.name: Refugio Dickson on Lago Dickson
points.note: Day 2-3: the back side opens up; the hut stands on a meadow with the Dickson glacier at the end of the lake.

points.name: Glaciar Los Perros
points.note: Day 3-4: the glacier lake right above the camp.

points.name: John Gardner Pass, Southern Ice Field view
points.note: Day 4-5: at the top the Grey glacier and the Ice Field fill the whole west.

points.name: Glaciar Grey hanging bridges
points.note: The steep descent along the glacier and its hanging bridges; then the W back east.
